column1: # Hex/binary literals are minilang kinds (+hb/…/, +bb/…/) covered in
# module-minilang.tsv; here we build byte inputs with `convert Bytes [..]`.
# convert: String/List <-> Bytes, and compact (Bytes -> Bytes)
# size via the generic word (Sizer behavior); é is two UTF-8 bytes
# slice (start end data, end-exclusive) + add concatenation
# equality + ordering + type predicate via behaviors
# pack via `make Bytes [spec]` — the spec is a JSON-representable List of
# segment Maps (ADR-007: no secondary parsing). `value` = a pack constant,
# `name` reads from scope; `size` is an int or a field-name String.
make Bytes [{value:1 type:'bits' size:4} {value:5 type:'bits' size:4}]
def body (convert Bytes "hi") def len (size body) make Bytes [{value:1 type:'u8'} {name:'len' type:'u16'} {name:'body' type:'bytes'}]
# `bytes [spec]` is sugar for `make Bytes [spec]` — same packer
def body (convert Bytes "hi") def len (size body) bytes [{value:1 type:'u8'} {name:'len' type:'u16'} {name:'body' type:'bytes'}]
(bytes [{value:1 type:'u8'} {value:2 type:'u16'}]) eq (make Bytes [{value:1 type:'u8'} {value:2 type:'u16'}])
# unpack: decode + bind, then read a field; literal guards
unpack (convert Bytes [1 0 2 104 105]) [{name:'ver' type:'u8'} {name:'len' type:'u16'} {name:'body' type:'bytes' size:'len'}] (convert String body)
unpack-prefix (convert Bytes [1 0 2 104 105 170]) [{name:'ver' type:'u8'} {name:'len' type:'u16'} {name:'body' type:'bytes' size:'len'}]
def x 1.5 def f (make Bytes [{name:'x' type:'f64' endian:'le'}]) unpack f [{name:'y' type:'f64' endian:'le'}] y
def x -2 def f (make Bytes [{name:'x' type:'i16'}]) unpack f [{name:'y' type:'i16'}] y
